text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (August 19, 2024) for 3 Anglesey Boulevard.

The Property Standards Commitee - Etobicoke York Panel 1. Amended the By-law Section of Item 1 on the Property Standards Order (August 19, 2024) for 3 Anglesey Boulevard, Folder Number 24 199651 PRS 00 IV to 19.D.(3)(g)[1][b] OR 19.D.(3)(g)[2], and in so doing granted an extension of time to August 29, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City. 2. Confirmed Items 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6 on the Property Standards Order (August 19, 2024) for 3 Anglesey Boulevard, Folder Number 24 199651 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension of time to August 29, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
